original_already_opened_endpoint.inference_label: This experiment is NOT independent or fully prospective, because native GPS and barometric heights were previously examined for the individual-identity question.

environmental_source.primary: CERRA site shortwave radiation 09–15 UTC, from latitude 44.2, longitude 3.25, monthly calendar-day lower/upper quartiles. A broad thermal-opportunity proxy, NOT physically observed thermal Wstar.
environmental_source.secondary: CERRA site wind_speed_100m 09–15 UTC, same dated monthly calendar-day Q25/Q75
environmental_source.environment_availability_preflight: diagnostic/france-gyps-CERRA-day-context-20261023, source metadata outcome-blind, 2019–2021, original 28 qualifying biological birds, first eligible GPS per 5 minute, with geodesy dummy excluded
environmental_source.weather_noncausal: Regional CERRA at Cassagne, not each GPS animal's experienced atmosphere, and cannot separate shared landscape/migration/weather.

source_filter.time_window: 2019–2021 all seasons; original source-visible, native speed 5–55m/s, valid WGS84 XY, earliest GPS fix per bird×UTC5min, independent of numerical native height availability
source_filter.biological_bird_selection: ONLY pre-height frozen original 28 biological bird IDs can enter; the source explicit geodesy tag and source nonqualifying birds cannot be added to rescue
source_filter.native_height_pair: GPS height-above-msl and bar:barometric-height both finite [-500,7000] meters on EXACT same original GPS fix, no substitutions
source_filter.paired_quality: Source wide ≥80% both-native-height availability, bird-day ≥50% paired first-selected points
source_filter.height_center: Each bird-day GPS and barometric column separately centered at its own median of all paired flying fixes across cells, ten fixed height bins [-inf,-200,-100,-50,-25,0,25,50,100,200,inf]
source_filter.source_bird_day: original GPS+BARO paired bird-day ≥50 selected first-5minute fixes, before environmental gain model and matched fine-cell test
source_filter.training: Same bird, same 5km cell, distinct UTC days, same chosen weather regime ≥10 other-day fixes and opposite weather regime ≥10 fixes in same cell
source_filter.reference: Same bird other-day wind/solar pooled daily-smoothed altitude probabilities across ALL low/middle/high dates in cell
source_filter.other_bird_support: At least10 other biological bird GPS fixes in same 5km cell on different UTC date, for exactly same target fixes; geodesy excluded.
source_filter.heldout_day: ≥50 scored fixes after other-day source support, ≥2 days in EACH low/high environmental regime per focal biological bird, n≥10 birds to report a fixed family
source_filter.weighting: Jeffreys 0.5 per 10-bin source bird-day-cell probability vector; equal scoring per GPS fix within day; equal bird-days within low/high; equal low/high bird states; equal biological birds
source_filter.source_artifact_bird_population: Frozen 28 preheight source birds, never include Test géodésie ornitela, do not shift spatial grain based on effect.

fixed_family.primary_context: solar; wind is secondary and not rescue if solar fails
fixed_family.null: 999 permutations of WHOLE CALENDAR DATE solar/wind low/middle/high labels within every original calendar YYYY-MM, SYNCHRONIZED across all birds in source, preserving original source year-season day mix
fixed_family.multiple_tests: Holm across all four sensor×environment comparisons. Unavailable context/sensor family member p=1 in Holm; do not use invalid-draw descriptive p as inferred value.
fixed_family.no_retuning: No change to original 28 individual source identities, 5km cells, 09–15 UTC weather, year-month Q25/Q75, 50 event daily min, height bins, missing altitude day source, perm labels to rescue non-significant outcomes.
fixed_family.no_independence_overstatement: GPS and BAROMETRIC are same native GPS points on same tagged birds; do not count sensor replicates as independent studies.

explicit_claim_limits: Not measurement of actual thermal uplift, not individual-specific response or causal adaptation.
A positive same-individual Wstar/solar model vs own-pooled shape could reflect a shared species-wide environmental reaction, not individual unique slope.
The original France altitude data already used to discover persistent shape; new weather association is postoutcome exploratory even with source threshold frozen now.
Outcome labels cannot be permuted independently by bird because solar/wind is COMMON on each site calendar day.
GPS altitude and barometric height can share tag calibration, their agreement is technical robustness only.
